title: Invitations that arrive
description: With Vyte you invite to your party: every guest gets a personal link, accepts or declines without an account and uploads their photos on the day itself.
heading: Invitations that arrive
lead: Create your event, send every guest a personal link and see at once who is coming. Your guests need no account for it.

preview.title: Anna turns 30
preview.hosts: Anna & Jonas want to celebrate with you.
preview.question: Are you in?

steps.heading: From the announcement to the photos

saveTheDate.heading: Save the date
saveTheDate.text: Announce the date early. Your guests add it to their calendar with one tap.

invitation.heading: Invitation with an answer
invitation.text: Every guest accepts or declines through their own link and says whom they bring. You see the answers in the guest list.

photos.heading: Photos of the evening
photos.text: Guests upload their photos through the QR code on their place card or at the photo stand. Only the hosts can see them.
